source.text:
Hey HN, I built Woodpecker: https://oakery.io/. It lets you reorganize websites and automate everyday workflows

I made a demo showing how it can help manage a Discord channel. Valuable user feedback often gets buried in everyday conversations. You can use Woodpecker with a Jev connector, and ask it to classify messages—for example, as bug reports, feature requests, or performance issues—and turn the results into a product roadmap

Of course, this can work on any website you’d like: filter your feed on X, classify posts on HN, etc.

Here is the Discord demo: https://video.oakery.io/setup-discord/

Let me know if this is helpful to you and what other workflows you’d like to use.
source.title: Show HN: Woodpecker – a browser agent built with Pi and user scripts
